description: Keyword search of mailing-list messages (BM25 over subject, sender and the authors' own words), every list unless inbox narrows it. Operators in query: s:/intitle: subject, f:/from: sender, b:/intext: body, after:/before:/d:2024-01..2025-01 dates, site:<list>, filetype:patch, link:<url glob>, /regex/. Returns messages best first (limit default 50, max 200; offset pages; collapse_threads=true keeps one per thread), each with inbox, message_id, subject, from, date, thread_id and an excerpt, plus total and has_more. Use it for exact words, names and identifiers; hybrid_search for questions. Cite as https://postgr.es/m/<message_id>. author, since and until restrict it to one sender and a date window. Echoes operators applied, warnings for dropped ones, skipped if mail is excluded; a query that cannot run is an error. complete=false when it ran out of budget_ms or total is a lower bound (timed_out, total_partial, total_capped say which). With define:<term> it also returns definition, the same card search_docs returns.

author.description: Only messages this person sent: a name, an e-mail address or hash:<8 hex> (a person page). Resolved to every address they post from; an ambiguous name returns the candidates to choose from.

budget_ms.description: Time budget in ms for the keyword search (100-15000; default 4500, the engine's own limits). complete=false in the reply when it ran out or a total is a lower bound.

collapse_threads.description: Deduplicate results to one per thread, keeping the highest-scoring hit (default false)

inbox.description: Lists to search: omit (or "all") for every list, the default; one name such as pgsql-bugs; or several, comma-separated ("pgsql-hackers,pgsql-bugs"). Names from list_inboxes. Aliases: list, inbox_name.

query.description: Search query string. Operators: after:/before:YYYY[-MM[-DD]], d:A..B, site:<list|docs|wiki|commits>, from:/author:, intitle:/s:, intext:/b:, to:/cc:, filetype:patch, has:patch, link:<url glob> (messages linking to a URL; link:example.org = any URL on that host), /regex/ (case:yes for case-sensitive), -operator to negate. Operators without words list matches newest first.

since.description: Only messages sent on or after this date (UTC): YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD, an ISO date-time, or 2w / 6m / 1y ago.

until.description: Only messages sent before this date (exclusive), same forms as since. With author: what that person had said by then.

name: search
